_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Canonical pricing lives in the private poddle-cloud repo (pricing/pricing.json) and is injected at deploy as pricing.generated.json by scripts/sync-pricing.mjs. Paid amounts are redacted here ($XX) on purpose so no commercial pricing lives in the AGPL repo; the layout is otherwise faithful.

tiers.name: Free
feats: Full audit trail on your own infra

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.tag: For one developer who wants it hosted.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.tag: For teams shipping with coding agents.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.tag: For orgs that answer to auditors.

managed.heading: Managed pods
managed.sub: Coming soon. We run the pods for you on EU infrastructure, metered per second with scale-to-zero when idle. Join the waitlist and we will tell you when it lands.
managed.note: Until then, bring your own compute - you keep full control and pay your provider directly.

byo.heading: Bring your own compute
byo.sub: Point poddle at your own cloud account or self-hosted runners. You pay your infrastructure provider directly - poddle only charges the per-developer broker fee.
feats: Your cloud or on-prem, your region
Data and compute stay in your account

included: No vendor secret inside the pod

faqs.a: Anyone in your org who spins up or drives a pod. Read-only viewers of an audit trail are free.

faqs.q: Do I pay poddle for compute?
faqs.a: No. Bring your own cloud or self-hosted compute and you pay that provider directly; poddle charges a per-developer fee for the hosted broker, identities, and audit trail. Managed pods, where we run the compute, are coming later.
Yes. The core is open source (AGPL-3.0) - self-host it free and the raw secret stays in a vault you control. The hosted cloud is the same broker with nothing for you to operate.
Yes - 14 days on Pro or Team, no card to start. Your pods and identities carry over if you keep going.
